description:
[Step 4 of find_a_clinician]

Returns a booking link pre-filled with the clinician, service, time, state and insurance. Nothing is booked: the family opens the link and completes checkout, which takes about 2 minutes. A Clinical Matching Session is service clinical-matching with an intake specialist.

Use when: A family has chosen a clinician and a time from get_availability.

Don't use when: No clinician or time yet: search_providers and get_availability come first.

Example: get_booking_link({ provider_id: '7598079', state: 'Texas', service: 'adhd-testing', date_time: '2026-10-29T14:00:00-05:00', insurance: 'Aetna' })

agent.description: Optional. Your agent or product name, e.g. "chatgpt". Added to the booking link as utm_source.

date_time.description: The date_time of a slot from get_availability, unchanged, e.g. "2026-10-29T14:00:00-05:00".

insurance.description: Insurance plan name, or "Cash Pay" for self-pay. A plan Emora does not take is ignored, and the result says so.

service.description: therapy (the default), clinical-matching (unsure what is needed), medication (non-stimulant only), adhd-testing or autism-testing.

state.description: U.S. state, full name or 2-letter code. For a state Emora does not serve, the result says so and lists alternatives.

name: get_booking_link
title: Get a booking link
